title: Fix run-length encoding to merge consecutive identical characters
prompt: The function encode(s) in starter/rle.py returns a run-length encoded list of (char, count) tuples. The bug is that it starts a new run for every character instead of incrementing the count for a run of identical characters. Fix it so that encode('aaabbc') == [('a', 3), ('b', 2), ('c', 1)] and encode('') == []. Also fix decode(pairs) which reconstructs the original string from a list of (char, count) tuples — it currently has an off-by-one and repeats each character count-1 times instead of count times. Do not edit the tests.
